kind_invalid.zh: 资源种类只能是 skill / mcp / material，得到 {kind!r}
kind_invalid.en: resource kind must be skill / mcp / material, got {kind!r}

locator_invalid.zh: locator 必须是 1..500 字符的非空文本
locator_invalid.en: locator must be non-empty text of 1..500 characters

digest_invalid.zh: digest 必须是 sha256:<64位小写十六进制>
digest_invalid.en: digest must be sha256:<64 lowercase hex>

target_kind_invalid.zh: target_kind 只能是 position 或 work，得到 {target_kind!r}
target_kind_invalid.en: target_kind must be position or work, got {target_kind!r}

not_project_manager.zh: {actor!r} 不能管理 Work {target_ref!r} 所在的项目，不能给它分配资源
not_project_manager.en: {actor!r} cannot manage the project of Work {target_ref!r}, so cannot assign resources to it

loaded_invalid.zh: loaded / usable 必须是布尔值
loaded_invalid.en: loaded and usable must be booleans

usable_needs_loaded.zh: 没有加载的资源不可能可用（usable 需要 loaded）
usable_needs_loaded.en: a resource that is not loaded cannot be usable (usable needs loaded)

no_binding.zh: 资源观测必须来自一个绑定窗口
no_binding.en: a resource observation must come from a bound window
